question: Under O. Reg. 129/04, what is the minimum licence class for an overall responsible operator of a Class III wastewater treatment facility?
options: A Class III wastewater treatment operator licence.
A Class II wastewater treatment operator licence.
A Class IV wastewater treatment operator licence only.
explanation: O. Reg. 129/04 requires an overall responsible operator to hold a licence applicable to the facility type and of the same class as or higher than the facility. Therefore, the minimum for a Class III wastewater treatment facility is a Class III wastewater treatment operator licence.
sourceTitle: Ontario Regulation 129/04 — Licensing of Sewage Works Operators
sourceReference: Section 15(1) requires the overall responsible operator to hold an applicable licence of the same class as or higher than the facility, and gives a Class III facility as an example requiring a Class III or Class IV licence.
